snippet.title: L'affaire Morlov (PC, English) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of Titus and CPIO's 1995 FMV/interactive movie game for Dos PCs, L'affaire Morlov.

Played through using the English option. This game saw a small English release as "value" software, sold as a jewel case with no box. The British release was still by default in French, though you can access the English version by typing "English" at the command prompt, or by starting the game and selecting English in the option panels. The game also saw a limited release on the CD-i. 

Talk about obscure! Try as I might, my internet searches of this one turn up virtually nothing. I vaguely recall playing it for a bit as a kid and loved it. Fairly recently I thought of it again, sought out a copy, and thankfully was able to get a hold of it without too much difficulty.

So, here is a fun, cheesy, and almost entirely unknown artifact of the era of FMV games. It's short and corny, but it's very entertaining. 
__________________
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
